title: The Adobe MAX Updates That Matter Have Nothing to Do With AI
excerpt: Adobe MAX 2026 led with AI agents, but the updates that change a learner's daily editing are quieter: virtual copies, burst stacks, Denoise for JPEGs, and LUTs in Camera Raw.

title: Why Platon Never Shows Anyone the Back of His Camera
excerpt: Platon has photographed presidents with 30 seconds and one frame. His rule: no tethering, no screen in the room, no reviewing frames mid-shoot, because the moment you show the back of the camera, the session stops being about the person.

title: Young Photographers Are Not Quitting Digital. They Are Printing Again.
excerpt: A survey of 4,000 Europeans found 8 in 10 young adults print their photos, and half of those printers want a retro look. The headline says film is back. The numbers say something better: people want their photos to exist.
